system.description: Magician Base 5.5 - Water Law. Spells to condense water, create/clear fog, conjure a wall of water, throw water bolts, calm water and command a boat's current, call rain, summon a whirlpool, part water, and summon a fierce sea storm, culminating in Water Mastery. Special Notes: All walls created by spells on this list must rest on a solid surface. See Section 15.7 (p. 97) for more on walls.
Condenses 1 cubic foot of water from the surrounding air. Water gradually condenses into caster's hands and may be funneled into any suitable receptacle.
Creates dense fog within up to 10' radius per level of the caster. See Section 15.12 (p. 98).
Creates a wall of water up to 10' x 10' x 1'. This wall reduces all movement through it by 80%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a -80 penalty.
A bolt of water is shot from the caster's palm. Resolve attack on the Water Bolt Attack Table 13.9 (p. 88).

Disperses any fog in the area of effect. If all of a fog is not dispersed (i.e., the fog covers a greater area than the area of effect for this spell), the fog will refill the area of effect at a rate of 10' radius every 1-5 minutes.
Water within radius is calmed. Waves are cut by 20' in center and less towards the perimeter.
As Waterwall, except for the duration.
As Water Bolt I, except range is 300'.
If there are clouds in the sky, it rains (outdoors) for the duration of the spell.
As Water Bolt I, except range is 500'.

Three bolts of water are shot from the palm of the caster. They can strike up to three different targets (as long as they are all within 60° of each other; and they are visible to the caster). Caster may apply his directed spell skill (Waterbolt) to only one of the attacks (the others get a +0 OB).

The area of effect for this spell is the water immediately surrounding the boat that the caster is on. For as long as the caster concentrates, the speed of the boat can be increased by 50' per round (approximately 3 miles per hour).
As Calm Water, except waves are cut by 50' in center and caster need not concentrate.
Creates a 50' whirlpool that will draw in any unpowered object within 500' (takes 2 minutes of concentration to start). Powered objects may make maneuver rolls to resist the pull of the whirlpool.
Caster can part water up to 100' deep and 100' per level long and 10' wide at bottom (50' at top).

Summons forces of nature in a fierce sea storm (must be created over a large body of water). This storm will include waves of 20-50', heavy rain, and winds of 25-60 mph. The storm can be delayed up to 1 hour per level. After the storm is summoned, it will dissipate normally.
Caster can use one lower level spell (on this list) each round.
